mcqs.question: Sri Modakondamma Jatara at Paderu was held in 2025 on which dates?
mcqs.explanation: The 2025 Sri Modakondamma Jatara was held on 11, 12 and 13 May. The other options omit one of the three festival dates.

mcqs.question: Sri Modakondamma Jatara is associated with which deity?
mcqs.explanation: The deity of Sri Modakondamma Jatara is Grama Devatha, described as a form of Goddess Durga. Kondhs and Koyas are the communities who revere the deity, not the deity itself.

mcqs.question: Which of the following statements about the rituals of Sri Modakondamma Jatara is incorrect?
options: The rituals include processions, tribal dances, community feasts, homams, abhishekam and alankaram.
The rituals include tribal dances, processions, homams, community feasts, alankaram and abhishekam.
The rituals include homams, abhishekam, alankaram, processions, tribal dances and community feasts.
The rituals include processions, tribal dances, community feasts, homams, abhishekam and processions.
mcqs.explanation: The incorrect statement replaces alankaram with a second mention of processions. The listed rituals are processions, tribal dances, community feasts, homams, abhishekam and alankaram.

mcqs.question: Who felicitated the students of Andhra Pradesh associated with the Inter-State Word Power Championship on 6 May 2025?
options: B. Srinivasa Rao, State Project Director, Samagra Shiksha AP
mcqs.explanation: B. Srinivasa Rao, State Project Director, Samagra Shiksha AP, felicitated the students on 6 May 2025. B. Revanth, B. Sindhu Priya and G. Jethin Manikantha were students associated with the achievement, not the felicitating official.

mcqs.question:
Match the students associated with the Inter-State Word Power Championship achievement with their class and school.

List-I
 a. B. Revanth
 b. B. Sindhu Priya
 c. G. Jethin Manikantha
 d. P. Charan Srinivas

List-II
 i. Class 4 — Kanimerla MPP School, NTR district
 ii. Class 2 — Kanimerla MPP School, NTR district
 iii. Class 3 — Vakkapattulavaripalem MPP School, Krishna district
 iv. Class 5 — MPP School, Vandalur RH, SPSR Nellore
mcqs.explanation: The correct pairs are a-i, b-ii, c-iii and d-iv. B. Revanth was in Class 4, B. Sindhu Priya in Class 2, G. Jethin Manikantha in Class 3 and P. Charan Srinivas in Class 5, with the corresponding schools shown in List-II.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:
Statement A: Samagra Shiksha was launched in 2019–20 by the Ministry of Education.
Statement B: Samagra Shiksha merged Sarva Shiksha Abhiyan, RMSA and the Ministry of Education.
options: Both Statement A and Statement B are true
Both Statement A and Statement B are false
Statement A is true, Statement B is false
Statement A is false, Statement B is true
mcqs.explanation: Both statements are false. Samagra Shiksha was launched in 2018–19 by the Ministry of Education, and it merged Sarva Shiksha Abhiyan, RMSA and Teacher Education.

mcqs.question:
Assertion (A): Samagra Shiksha supports the RTE Act, 2009.
Reason (R): Samagra Shiksha supports the RTE Act, 2010.
options: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
mcqs.explanation: Assertion A is true because Samagra Shiksha supports the RTE Act, 2009. Reason R is false because the stated year is 2009, not 2010.
